newsitem.title: USA: Rogers names Walter Boomer as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rogers names Walter Boomer as CEO.

text.p: Rogers Corp said Friday it had appointed Walter Boomer as president and chief executive officer.
Boomer succeeds Harry Birkenruth, who will become chairman of the board, it said.
"Over the next year, prior to my retirement, Walt (Boomer) and I will work closely together to effectively transition to his leadership," Birkenruth was quoted as saying in a company statement.
Boomer previously was president of Babcock and Wilcox Power Generation Group.
Rogers makes components and specialty materials for the communications and transportation markets, among others.
